question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hopefully, things will return to normal in the __________.
solution:
The correct answer is, **'Future'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The usage of 'will' in the sentence indicates the Future Tense.
 
• Future Tense tells about the things that haven
